entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: Okay, I wonder who the next idol could be….

entries.speaker: Ariana Grande
entries.text: I see it, I like it, I want it, I got it

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: Wait… is that Ariana Grande? Why is she competing in an underground college battle in China?! She’s literally a global superstar!

entries.speaker: CupcakKe
entries.text: Looks like the competition just got a lot more expensive.

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: Or maybe the developer is just an arianator.

entries.speaker: CupcakKe
entries.text: Shhh…. Don’t break the fourth wall.

entries.speaker: Ariana Grande
entries.text: Thank u, next. You're cute, but I'm a girl with a whole lot of baggage. This crown? It’s mine. God is a woman, and today, she’s wearing a ponytail.

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: Excuse me? I’ve spent my whole semester studying uhh…. Calculus? Okay that’s not related but you can’t just walk in here and act like you own the place!

entries.speaker: Ariana Grande
entries.text: Focus on me. If you want to win, you have to prove you’re not just a glitch in the system.

entries.speaker: Ariana Grande
entries.text: You think you’re ready? I’m switchin' the positions for you. Get on stage, and sing, until your last breath!

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: Fine! Let’s see if you can handle a digital diva!
